reason: form controls: the user agent style sheet of the library is the one of HTML, which gives the controls no font, paddings, borders nor margins; the browsers give them a font of 13.333px (11px in Safari), and Chromium and Firefox a padding of 1px 2px and a border of 2px inset to the text fields, a padding of 2px to the textarea elements, margins to the checkboxes and the radio buttons (the native frame of the library takes no space)
font fallback: the disclosure triangles of the markers of the summary elements (U+25B8, U+25BE) are not in the injected font
Chromium and WebKit give the wbr elements no box (getBoundingClientRect() returns an empty rectangle at the origin); Firefox and the library give them a box of zero width on the line
